name: The tab that waited for the lock in vain drops the token instead of renewing with it
description: The first tab holds the lock with a renewal whose request never leaves the browser: the provider never sees it, so the token is not spent, and the lock is not released either. The second tab waits for that lock and gives up on it. The one thing it must not do then is renew with the same refresh token, because that second use is what ends the whole session. It takes the token out of the storage instead and sends nothing at all.
descriptionHtml:
The first tab holds the lock with a renewal whose request never leaves the browser: the provider never sees it, so the token is not spent, and the lock is not released either. The second tab waits for that lock and gives up on it. The one thing it must not do then is renew with the same refresh token, because that second use is what ends the whole session. It takes the token out of the storage instead and sends nothing at all.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Feature.signInAgain.TokenRenewalAcrossTabsTest#lockHeldTooLong_theTokenIsDroppedAndNotSent into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH

testStage.description: The first tab holds the lock with a renewal whose request never leaves the browser: the provider never sees it, so the token is not spent, and the lock is not released either. The second tab waits for that lock and gives up on it. The one thing it must not do then is renew with the same refresh token, because that second use is what ends the whole session. It takes the token out of the storage instead and sends nothing at all.
testStage.descriptionHtml:
The first tab holds the lock with a renewal whose request never leaves the browser: the provider never sees it, so the token is not spent, and the lock is not released either. The second tab waits for that lock and gives up on it. The one thing it must not do then is renew with the same refresh token, because that second use is what ends the whole session. It takes the token out of the storage instead and sends nothing at all.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Feature.signInAgain.TokenRenewalAcrossTabsTest#lockHeldTooLong_theTokenIsDroppedAndNotSent into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
